title: REQ · Game store holds the focused object id
description: Context: useGameStore in game/frontend/src/store/gameStore.ts holds only state, setState and init. Desired behavior: add a focusedObjectId field (default null) and a setFocusedObject action. Expected result: any module can set and read the focused object id. Why: the scene needs a shared place to read focus from.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fresh store, when focusedObjectId is read, then it is null
Given the store, when setFocusedObject('bookshelf') is called, then focusedObjectId is 'bookshelf'
Given a focused id, when setFocusedObject(null) is called, then focusedObjectId is null
technical_constraints: Keep init and setState behavior unchanged
definition_of_done: Field and action exist with typed signatures
